verdict.rationale: A hands-on probe fetched a public OpenAPI document for the Harbor Compliance API at /api/v3/openapi. It returned HTTP 200 without a key, contained the "openapi" key, and was read in full (681,444 chars, including registered-agent-deliveries endpoints). The claimed-docs items on auth, rate limits and idempotency are sourced from that same spec URL, which supports its depth. Missing for 10: explicit first-party developer-portal documentation advertising the spec download (the portal is a JS-rendered shell), and no independent third-party corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)

citations.quote: a public, keyless OpenAPI document for the Harbor Compliance API (OAuth-authenticated at runtime)
